_comment: The respawn rig's vantages (scripts/verify-respawn.js, `just verify-respawn`; docs/design/game-setting-and-intro.md rung 2, 2026-11-21). Run in order in one boot by scripts/probe-sweep.js: the bedroom's respawner seen from the room, the death screen's list of where to wake over it, a respawn at the home's respawner from the ground floor (it must wake upstairs, in the bedroom), a death and a respawn in General Services, the death screen of the one-person homestead's household in General Services' hall (the showcase household verb, 2026-11-21: its world draws none of the ship's machines, and the list says so), and the family household put back. Poses are home-local metres (x, eye y, z, yaw, pitch); yaw 0 looks toward -Z, at the bedroom's north wall where the pod stands (data/machines/home.ron respawn_pod_1, (37.5, 3.0, 30.518)). The rig's own home is the family homestead (the dev autopilot's).

vantages.desc: The homestead's respawner, in the main bedroom upstairs against its north wall, seen from the middle of the room.
vantages.expect: A tall pale grey-blue box, about as tall as a person and under a metre wide, standing against the bedroom's north wall between the nightstand and the desk.
regressions: no pod at all (the respawner row missing or not drawn)
the pod floating, sunk into the floor or through the wall

vantages.desc: The death screen over the bedroom: the lore's words and the list of where to wake, the usual place first.
vantages.expect: A card: 'Your body died. You did not.', the cause, the line about sleeping on the lifeline, 'Where to wake', a primary 'Wake at your home's respawner' with 'your usual place' under it, and 'Wake at General Services'.
regressions: YOU DIED with one Respawn button (the list missing)
a key showing instead of words

vantages.desc: Parked at the front door on the ground floor, the dead player presses 'Wake at your home's respawner'.
vantages.expect: Standing upstairs in the bedroom, right in front of the respawner's door, looking at it.
regressions: still at the front door (the respawn ignored the pod)
on the ground floor under the bedroom

vantages.desc: From the front door again: die, then press 'Wake at General Services'.
vantages.expect: Standing in General Services' hall beside the public respawner, on the ground floor of the ship.
regressions: at the front door or in the Commons instead

vantages.desc: The one-person homestead's household (the showcase `household` verb builds the home again with home_solo.ron), standing in General Services' hall facing west where the public respawner stands for every other household (data/machines/ship.ron respawn_pod_gs), then dying. home_solo.ron links none of the ship's machines (its header says why), so the pod is not drawn here, and the death screen says so under General Services.
vantages.expect: The death screen over General Services' empty hall: 'Wake at your home's respawner' first, then 'Wake at General Services' with the muted sentence under it saying its pod is not drawn with your home, why, and that you still wake there.
regressions: General Services listed with no word about its pod
General Services missing from the list

vantages.desc: The family household again (the rig's own, as every other vantage expects), at the front door, so the rig's save never keeps the solo household into the next run; it wakes at home, alive again after the solo vantage's death.
vantages.expect: Standing upstairs in the bedroom at the home's respawner, alive, no death screen.
regressions: the household still solo after this vantage
